mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals robust economic conditions supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal continued economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during the late-cycle expansion regime (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST growth > 0.3%) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0%) signals robust economic activity supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth rate > 0.3% and CPIAUCSL growth rate > 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST growth > 0.3% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime, strong consumer credit (RSAFS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during the post-shock recovery regime (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
